breaking.change: Removed behavior declarations from CSS and their old reflected attributes, without aliases.
breaking.fix: Use data-fill-origin and data-min-gap on input type=range, data-cycle on select, data-detents and data-edge on dialog, and data-hit-slop on any element. Bindings, events, pointer priority, sheet drag/snap state and checkpointing are unchanged.

breaking.change: Removed the proprietary number-input styling and reflected attributes. Number inputs use the editable field with spinner buttons, not the f32-only stepper widget.
breaking.fix: Use input type=number with min, max, step, data-wrap and data-large-step. Data-format affects only unfocused presentation. Raw text, selection, validation, readonly focus and the pad keyboard remain available.
